simplegadgets.guide.page.1.title: Simple Gadgets
simplegadgets.guide.page.1: Gadgets you hold and use: for now the Gauge - a speed dial, an altimeter that warns of fall damage and auto-walk along paths and rails.
simplegadgets.guide.page.2.title: Gauge
simplegadgets.guide.page.2: The Gauge shows speed while held in either hand, with an animated item needle and a HUD dial.
simplegadgets.guide.page.3.title: Readout box
simplegadgets.guide.page.3: A held Gauge shows its readout in a small dark box next to the crosshair: the item's name as the title, a speed dial with the number in blocks per second, and further lines.
simplegadgets.guide.page.4.title: Readout box
simplegadgets.guide.page.4: With SimpleBuilding the box stacks with the Octant's and the Resonance Rod's boxes (Octant on top, then Gauge, then Rod) and
simplegadgets.guide.page.5.title: Readout box
simplegadgets.guide.page.5: follows SimpleBuilding's HUD position, size and HUD key; alone it sits at the left edge in the middle of the screen.
simplegadgets.guide.page.6.title: Moved from SimpleBuilding
simplegadgets.guide.page.6: The Gauge, its recipe and recipe unlock were SimpleBuilding's (simplebuilding:*).
simplegadgets.guide.page.7.title: Moved from SimpleBuilding
simplegadgets.guide.page.7: Old worlds load them under simplegadgets:* through SimpleLib's id moves and save the new ids - in inventories, chests and on the ground alike.
simplegadgets.guide.page.8.title: Creative tabs
simplegadgets.guide.page.8: Own tab with the gadgets and the guide. Without SimpleBuilding the gadgets also sit behind the recovery compass in the Vanilla tools tab (switch addItemsToVanillaTabs); with SimpleBuilding its tabs list them in their old places.
simplegadgets.guide.page.9.title: Creative tabs
simplegadgets.guide.page.9: Switched off (SimpleBuilding's Enable Simple Gadgets), the tab and the Vanilla tab entries are empty; the gadgets keep working.
